clips.title: The story
paras: The Divining Scroll is an enchanted parchment provided by Sentinel Velene Starstrike at Silverwind Refuge. Its magic allows investigators to trace the magical signature of the unnatural water elementals infesting Ashenvale back to their creator.

When corrupt water elementals began rising from the pristine pools of Ashenvale, the Sentinels knew the disturbance was not a natural emergence. Sentinel Velene Starstrike acquired this divination scroll to identify the person responsible. By channeling the scroll's magic through intact elemental bracers as a focusing reagent, the user extracts the summoner's signature, transforming the blank parchment into a Divined Scroll that names the guilty party.
